requirements.description: Proposals must address next-generation AI agents defined as autonomous systems powered by large AI language models (including large language models or large multimodal models) that can plan, utilise tools, and perform actions autonomously to achieve specified goals based on high-level instructions.

Effective AI agent designs must incorporate structured planning and reasoning methods to manage complex tasks, and be equipped with appropriate validation and monitoring techniques. Multi-agent collaboration frameworks are identified as further enhancing capabilities through structured agent interactions.
All proposals are expected to incorporate mechanisms for assessing and demonstrating progress, including qualitative and quantitative KPIs, benchmarking, and progress monitoring.
All proposals are expected to allocate tasks for cohesion activities with the European Partnership on AI, data, and robotics (ADRA) and the CSA HORIZON-CL4-2025-03-HUMAN-18: GenAI4EU central Hub.
Communicable results must be shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform.
Projects must link to the resources offered by the AI Factories, including the Data Labs.
When possible, proposals should build on and reuse public results from relevant previous funded actions.
Results may be validated in the Testing and Experiment Facilities and further deployed via the European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs).
Proposals should build on or seek collaboration with relevant projects and develop synergies with other relevant International, European, national, or regional initiatives.
Potential research area: enhancing AI agent autonomy through advanced self-planning and self-optimization capabilities, enabling agents to improve their decision-making and strategic planning.
Potential research area: innovation in memory-augmented AI agents to facilitate robust long-term reasoning and lifelong learning.
Potential research area: developing advanced multi-agent frameworks specifically tailored for collaborative agents, including research on AI agent frameworks based on mixed AI architectures.
Potential research area: advancing multimodal reasoning capabilities to enable real-world applications.

Award portfolio management requires coverage of at least one proposal focusing on each of three sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving — subject to proposals passing all evaluation thresholds.
